form.name: Name *
form.gender: Gender (optional, used to restrict gender-specific leave types such as menstrual leave)
form.attendanceAccount: Attendance Account (optional, used to match records imported from the external time-clock system)
form.monthlySalary: Monthly Salary (optional, used to estimate unused annual leave payout)
form.initialAnnualLeaveUsed: Annual Leave Days Used (optional, only for employees who joined before this system and already used annual leave)
form.initialCarriedInDays: Annual Leave Days Carried In (optional, only for employees past their first anniversary with leave carried over from the previous period)
form.initialCarriedInDaysHint: Carried-in days must be used within this period, otherwise they are cashed out at the anniversary settlement; days already used are applied to them first.
form.scheduleModeHint: Shift schedule: rest days, mandatory days off and national holidays are all shifted to other days; day types and holiday allowances are determined by the individual's schedule (shifts and day-off marks from the attendance import).
form.attendanceSourceHint: Employees set to "System punch" clock in from their portal; external attendance imports skip them so punch records are never overwritten.
form.punchIpExempt: Exempt from punch IP restriction (field staff)

addDialog.title: Add Employee
addDialog.description: Fill in the new employee's basic information. Fields marked with * are required.

editDialog.title: Edit Employee
editDialog.description: Update the employee's basic information. Fields marked with * are required.

delete.title: Confirm Delete Employee
delete.message: Are you sure you want to delete employee <1>{{name}} ({{employeeId}})</1>? This action cannot be undone.

terminate.title: Confirm Mark Employee as Terminated
terminate.message: Are you sure you want to mark employee <1>{{name}} ({{employeeId}})</1> as terminated?

import.title: Bulk Import Employees
import.description: Upload a CSV file, or paste the content directly. The header row must include "姓名、員工編號、部門、職位、電子郵件、到職日" (name, employee ID, department, position, email, join date); phone, address, notes, monthly salary, gender, attendance account, annual leave days used, and annual leave days carried over from the previous period (header "上期遞延天數") are optional (gender should be "男" or "女", used to restrict gender-specific leave types such as menstrual leave; attendance account is used to match records imported from the external time-clock system). A login account is created automatically for each employee (username = email, default password = employee ID).

compensation.title: Compensation & Insurance
compensation.description: Salary change history and labor insurance, health insurance and pension data (HR and admin only). The currently effective salary is also used for leave and comp-time cash-out.
compensation.formHint: Enter insured salaries and pension wage according to the official brackets. They are recorded only; premiums are not calculated automatically yet. A new entry is pre-filled from the latest one, so only change what differs.
compensation.deleteHint: The record effective {{date}} will be deleted. At least one record must remain.
